```yaml
name: Format

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  format:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rustfmt
          cache: true

      - name: Check code formatting
        uses: actions-rust-lang/rustfmt@v1
```

yaml:
name: Format

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  format:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rustfmt
          cache: true

      - name: Check code formatting
        uses: actions-rust-lang/rustfmt@v1
